players.product: Apple Silicon (A19 / A19 Pro, M5) — leading-edge logic on TSMC N2/N3

quarterly_data.signal: Apple announced Apple Home Collection on October 13, 2026: smart home accessories (indoor and outdoor cameras, thermostats, temperature sensors, a video doorbell and a door lock) designed in collaboration with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric and managed through the Apple Home app. The lineup includes LG's four cameras (up to 2.5K video), the LG Smart Deadbolt Lock (Ultra Wideband, Matter, Aliro), an LG Smart Thermostat and temperature sensor, and the Schneider Home Smart Thermostat and Room Sensor. 'Availability for all products begins in December, with select accessories available starting early 2027', sold at apple.com/store, in the Apple Store app and at Apple Store locations; the LG Temperature Sensor and Schneider Home Room Sensor start at $39.95 and the LG Floodlight Cam starts at $399.95 (U.S.). Apple Retail now offers third-party installation from ADT in the U.S. starting this fall. Matthew Costello, Apple's vice president of Hardware Engineering: 'Working closely with industry leaders LG Electronics and Schneider Electric, we designed every accessory to work seamlessly with Apple Home'.
quarterly_data.figure: available from December, select accessories early 2027; sensors from $39.95; LG Floodlight Cam from $399.95
